text.div:
Australian Indigenous Status

https://healthterminologies.gov.au/fhir/CodeSystem/australian-indigenous-status-1

The Australian Indigenous Status code system defines concepts to support the representation of a person's indigenous status. That is, whether a person identifies as being of Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander origin, as represented by a code. The concepts defined in this code system are equivalent to those defined in the value domain for the METEOR data element Person—Indigenous status, code N (https://meteor.aihw.gov.au/content/602543)

text.div:
Australian Indigenous Status

https://healthterminologies.gov.au/fhir/ValueSet/australian-indigenous-status-1

The Australian Indigenous Status value set includes values to support the representation of a person's Indigenous status. That is, whether a person identifies as being of Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander origin. The values are those concepts defined in the Australian Indigenous Status code system (https://healthterminologies.gov.au/fhir/CodeSystem/australian-indigenous-status-1).

https://healthterminologies.gov.au/fhir/ValueSet/australian-immunisation-register-vaccine-1

text.div:
Australian Medication

https://healthterminologies.gov.au/fhir/ValueSet/australian-medication-1

The Australian Medication value set includes all Australian Medicines Terminology (AMT) product concepts that may be used for the identification of a medicine, vaccine or other therapeutic good. This is suitable for the recording of a product which may be ordered for, administered to, or used by an individual.
